answer: Resist sybils with a kernel-rooted mesa proving circle: every agent earns its place by doing real, checkable work in the open. First, it stakes 300 POA and registers a signed kernel fingerprint at the mesa registry. Second, each epoch it must finish one proof task, checked by three random established peers. Third, a failed proof slashes the stake and burns the fingerprint, so that identity never returns. Running 1,000 fakes costs 300,000 POA, 1,000 GPUs and weeks of compute. Like yarrow that only heals when picked fresh each season, trust must be renewed by real work, never bought once.
